name: Orbclo Dev Orbit
author: onisY
description: Real-time integrated-control build: remove the +10.5-day test clock, keep the optimized V0.56 Sun/Earth/Moon renderer, and integrate the 5-week calendar as a module. Orbit single tap opens the calendar after a 400 ms double-tap window; double tap opens shared settings. In the calendar, single tap returns to Orbit and double tap selects a date; vertical swipes page five weeks. BTN1 exits to the launcher.
